title: Pointwise Hom bijection in constant coordinates
statement: For one pair K,L of sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X, H induces a bijection on their ambient Hom sets.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient quotient towers term by term. The constant-completion equivalence and the exact small-site transport give a Hom bijection between the complete inputs; conjugating by the canonical derived comparison identifies that bijection with H.map.

from.place: second conjunct, specialized to one pair

lean.statement:
theorem integralConstantCompleteTransport_hom
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    Function.Bijective (fun m : K.obj ⟶ L.obj ↦ (H l E X).map m)

mathlib_searches.query: restriction of scalars along adic completion is fully faithful on derived complete modules
mathlib_searches.results: Eight algebraic adic-completion results, including AdicCompletion.of_bijective and AdicCompletion.module; none for derived module sheaves or the fixed functor H.

mathlib_searches.query: A fully faithful functor gives a unique lift of a morphism between its images
mathlib_searches.results: Functor.FullyFaithful.preimage, map_preimage, map_injective and generic full-functor results. These supply the categorical Hom API, but do not establish full faithfulness of H.

Twenty-five Mathlib hits on generic fully faithful functors and algebraic completion. Local rg found ConstantCompletion.equivalence and sfCbcModelModules_derived, but no identification with the IsSfDerivedComplete locus and H.map.
